mentions.name: Hoamy
mentions.description: This app is an HOA management platform that includes every feature a small HOA might need, and lets users easily export all their data whenever they want, avoiding vendor lock-in and lowering the entry bar.
mentions.problem: Existing platforms tend to take users' data hostage with no easy way to egress, which raises the barrier to adopting them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://hoamy.app 
An easy HOA management platform that has every feature a small HOA might need. Because I like to think I'm not too ignorant, I can imagine at some point in time people might want to egress from the platform for whatever reason. And I wish more platforms would do this, but because I don't like taking people hostage, if they're not satisfied with the platform after having used it for a while, they can easily export all their data again. This should lower the entry bar.

mentions.name: Hoamy
mentions.description: This app is a self-built homeowners association (HOA) management system, created as an alternative after disappointment with the author's existing HOA management software. It is implemented with Nuxt and Nuxt UI; AI was used during development for generating similar pages and reviewing code.
mentions.problem: Existing HOA management systems were disappointing, prompting a self-built alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was kind of disappointed at our HOA management system so I made my own: https://hoamy.app
